server.name: gemini-enterprise-demo-mcp
server.description: Dummy Enterprise IT & Operations MCP Server protected by Google Identity (OIDC) for Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI Agent Builder.
server.instructions: Use these tools to look up employee directory details, check IT service desk ticket statuses, create new IT support tickets, and calculate cloud hardware budget quotes.

tools.name: lookup_employee_directory
tools.description: Looks up an employee's department, title, manager, location, and cost center by email or name.

employee_query.description: Employee email address or full name (e.g. 'alex@company.com' or 'Alex Rivera')

tools.name: check_it_ticket_status
tools.description: Checks the real-time status, assigned engineer, and resolution SLA of an IT Service Desk ticket.

mock_response.last_note: Verified Google Cloud IAM invoker permissions; provisioning access group.

tools.name: create_it_support_ticket
tools.description: Creates a new internal IT support ticket for access requests, software provisioning, or incident reporting.

requester_email.description: Email address of the employee requesting support

summary.description: Brief summary of the request or issue

tools.name: calculate_cloud_budget_quote
tools.description: Calculates an internal budget quote for cloud compute reservations with volume discounts and tax.

unit_price.description: Monthly cost per GPU/TPU node in USD

resources.name: Enterprise IT & Cloud Security Guidelines
resources.description: Standard operating policy for GCP IAM, OIDC authentication, and ticket escalation.

static_content.auth_standard: Google Cloud OIDC + Cloud Run IAM Invoker

prompts.name: onboard_new_engineer
prompts.description: Workflow to look up an employee and file their GCP IAM access ticket

arguments.name: employee_email
arguments.description: Email of the engineer being onboarded

prompts.template: Please look up '{employee_email}' using `lookup_employee_directory`, and then create a `gcp_iam_access` support ticket for them using `create_it_support_ticket` referencing their department and cost center.
